#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;
const ll MOD = 1000000007;
const ll INF = (ll)1e18 + 1;

ll nCr[100][100];

ll f(ll p, int a, int b, int c, int d) {
    p = p * nCr[a][b] % MOD;
    p = p * nCr[c][d] % MOD;
    return p;
}

struct State {
    int x, y, z;
    State(int x, int y, int z) : x(x), y(y), z(z) {}
};

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    int n, K;
    cin >> n >> K;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= i; j++) {
            if (j == 0 || j == i) nCr[i][j] = 1;
            else nCr[i][j] = (nCr[i-1][j] + nCr[i-1][j-1]) % MOD;
        }
    }
    
    int cnt1 = 0, cnt2 = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int x;
        cin >> x;
        if (x == 50) cnt1++;
        else cnt2++;
    }
    
    ll dist[200][200][2];
    ll dp[200][200][2];
    for (int i = 0; i < 200; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < 200; j++) {
            dist[i][j][0] = dist[i][j][1] = INF;
            dp[i][j][0] = dp[i][j][1] = 0;
        }
    }
    dist[0][0][0] = 0;
    dp[0][0][0] = 1;
    
    queue<State> q;
    q.push(State(0, 0, 0));
    
    while (!q.empty()) {
        State cur = q.front();
        q.pop();
        int x = cur.x, y = cur.y, z = cur.z;
        ll d = dist[x][y][z];
        int limX = (z == 0) ? cnt1 - x : x;
        int limY = (z == 0) ? cnt2 - y : y;
        for (int a = 0; a <= limX; a++) {
            for (int b = 0; b <= limY; b++) {
                if (a + b == 0) continue;
                if (a * 50 + b * 100 > K) break;
                int nx = (z == 0) ? x + a : x - a;
                int ny = (z == 0) ? y + b : y - b;
                int nz = z ^ 1;
                if (dist[nx][ny][nz] >= d + 1) {
                    ll add = f(dp[x][y][z], limX, a, limY, b);
                    if (dist[nx][ny][nz] > d + 1) {
                        dist[nx][ny][nz] = d + 1;
                        q.push(State(nx, ny, nz));
                    }
                    dp[nx][ny][nz] = (dp[nx][ny][nz] + add) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    if (dist[cnt1][cnt2][1] == INF) cout << -1 << '\n';
    else cout << dist[cnt1][cnt2][1] << '\n';
    cout << dp[cnt1][cnt2][1] << '\n';
    
    return 0;
}
